items.text: SEARCHING THROUGH THE RUBBLE YOU FIND A HIDDEN TUNNEL LEADING DOWN. DO YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: SEARCHING THROUGH THE SWAMP YOU FIND A HIDDEN TUNNEL LEADING DOWN. DO YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: FROM NEARBY A GROUP OF LIZARD MEN APPEAR. ONE LARGER THAN THE REST MOVES TO THE FRONT, 'YOUR TIME IS THROUGH OLD ONE. YOUR CLAWS ARE BLUNT.' 'FACE ME OR FIND SOME FOOL TO CHAMPION YOU!' THE OLD LIZARD MAN TURNS TO YOU AND SAYS, 'OUR CAUSE IS ONE. WILL YOU CHAMPION ME?'
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: SEEING THEIR LEADER FALL, THE OTHER LIZARD MEN WITHDRAW. THE OLD LIZARD MAN TURNS TO YOU, 'YOU HAVE DONE ME GREAT SERVICE. REST ASSURED THAT MY PEOPLE WILL NOT JOIN TYRANTHRAXUS.' 'STILL MY PEOPLE STILL ARE HOSTILE TO STRANGERS. I THINK IT IS BEST IF YOU LEAVE.' HE TURNS AND DISAPPEARS INTO THE WILDERNESS.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: SUDDENLY LIZARD MEN JUMP UP FROM WHERE THEY WERE HIDING AND THROW JAVELINS AT YOU. AT THE SAME TIME GIANT LIZARDS CHARGE OUT OF HIDDEN TUNNELS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE TUNNEL BEGINS TO SLOPE UP. DO YOU GO UP?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: DO YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SENSE AN ANTI-MAGIC SHELL AROUND YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AHEAD OF YOU IS A MOAT FILLED WITH SLUDGE AND THORNS. YOU CANNOT PROCEED BECAUSE THE MUD WOULD SURELY DRAG YOU DOWN TO YOUR DEATH.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ARE NO LONGER GOING DOWN. SUDDENLY YOU HEAR A NOISE. THERE ARE GIANT LIZARDS CHARGING! THERE IS NO TIME TO REACT. COMBAT IS UPON YOU!
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND AN OLD AND PARTIALLY BLOCKED SET OF STAIRS LEADING DOWN INTO THE DARK. DO YOU TAKE THEM?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND SOME TREASURE!
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AN OLD LIZARDMAN APPEARS BEFORE YOU, HAND RAISED IN A GESTURE OF PEACE.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: HE LOOKS AT YOU PATIENTLY.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: YOU LASH OUT WITH YOUR WEAPON DEALING ONE SWIFT, DEADLY BLOW. THE OLD LIZARD MAN TOTTERS FOR A MOMENT WITH A SURPRISED LOOK ON HIS FACE, AND THEN COLLAPSES.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: A GROUP OF HUMANS WERE DESCRIBED TO ME BY THREE OF OUR PEOPLE WHOM THEY RESCUED. IF YOU ARE THEY YOU WILL HAVE BEEN SHOWN OUR TRIBAL FRIEND-WORD.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: WHAT IS IT?
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: 'YOU ARE NOT THEY WHO RESCUED MY CHILDREN, BUT ARE MURDEROUS PIRATES! THEN YOU ARE NOT SAFE HERE!' HE DISAPPEARS WITH AMAZING SPEED INTO THE WILDERNESS AROUND YOU.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THE OLD LIZARD MAN RECOGNIZES THE WORD AND HIS LIPS PART IN A TOOTHY GRIN. YOU ALL GATHER CLOSE AS HE BEGINS HIS STORY.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: ONE OF YOU BUSILY SCRIBBLE IT INTO THE JOURNAL AS ENTRY 31.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: PLEASE, BE SERIOUS.
items.direction: perform the old lizardman consistently as aged, deliberate, dignified, and tribal; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: DRYTHH TURNS TO HIS CONFIDENT FOLLOWERS, 'KILL THEM!'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: 'THEN I MUST FIGHT HIM MYSELF.' THE COMBAT IS EXTREMELY SHORT IN DURATION. WHEN IT IS FINISHED DRYTHH TURNS TO HIS FOLLOWERS, 'KILL THEM!'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: YOU ENTER A BUILDING WHOSE WALLS ARE MORE OR LESS INTACT, THOUGH THE ROOF HAS FALLEN IN. RUBBLE MAKES PASSAGE DIFFICULT.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 2 LIZARD MEN AND A GIANT LIZARD CHARGE AT YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: SUDDENLY YOU ARE ATTACKED BY TWO LIZARD MEN AND A GIANT LIZARD!
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ENTER THE REMAINS OF THE CENTRAL KEEP. THE CEILING AND WALLS HAVE COLLAPSED TO THE POINT WHERE THE INTERIOR IS CHOKED WITH RUBBLE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HAVE ENTERED AN L-SHAPED BUILDING. IT IS REASONALBLY INTACT... THERE ARE EVEN PORTIONS OF ROOF OVERHEAD!
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 3 GIANT LIZARDS CHARGE TOWARD YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: SUDDENLY 3 GIANT LIZARDS APPEAR FROM BEHIND A MOUND OF RUBBLE. YOU FREEZE A MOMENT AS THEY CHARGE YOU!
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND A SET OF STAIRS LEADING UP.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A GROUP OF LIZARD MEN SLITHER OUT OF THE WATER AND THROW JAVELINS AT YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THEY TURN TO DIVE BACK IN THE WATER.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEFORE YOU CAN REACT THEY TURN AND DIVE BACK INTO THE WATER.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEFORE THEY CAN RETURN TO THE WATER YOU ENGAGE THEM. THEY TURN AND FIGHT FANATICALLY.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ARE IN FRONT OF A DEEP POOL OF WATER. DO YOU WISH TO DIVE IN AND SEARCH IT?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU DIVE INTO THE POOL AND BEGIN TO SEARCH BY TOUCH. SUDDENLY BEFORE YOUR CLOUDED VISION YOU SEE SOME LIZARD MEN...
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU MANAGE TO GET OUT OF THE POOL BEFORE THEY FINISH YOU OFF.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND SOME TREASURE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SEARCH UNTIL YOU FEEL THE PULSE POUNDING IN YOUR EARS. NOTHING IS FOUND. WITH THAT YOU RESURFACE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene
